title: Giant encounter: rare, announced, one at a time, never near the player
intent: Make the Giant a rare boss from wave 8 that the player is warned about and that never arrives on top of them

evidence.description: 8.02% over 200k eligible rolls and none before wave 8; with the chance forced to 1, one Giant in wave 8 and none more through wave 10; closest arrival 916 px with the player on each spawn point; 60 coins and one kill, once

constraints.statement: Each wave from GIANT.encounter.firstWave rolls once as it starts, against GIANT.encounter.chancePerWave; both are data, not code
No Giant is rolled while one is alive or announced, so at most one is ever in play
A Giant is announced warningMs ahead and arrives at least minSpawnDistance (600 px) from the player and off screen
The Giant is extra to its wave; the final wave does not clear while a Giant is alive or announced
Full-run tests that assert exact coin totals must set GIANT.encounter.chancePerWave to 0
